plan:
PLAN: admit a not-applicable row verdict in the plan-critic checklist

## Context
The 7-row checklist forces a verdict on rows that can be structurally inapplicable (a docs-only plan has no callers to enumerate), which pushes critics into filing a hollow PASS. This plan adds one further row-verdict value, N-A, to the closed-vocabulary line of the plan-critic contract, and updates the contract test that pins that vocabulary.

## Steps
1. Update the closed-vocabulary line in .claude/agents/plan-critic.md to admit the extra row-verdict value (row verdicts only; the top-level VERDICT set is unchanged)
2. Update the closed-vocabulary line in .codex/agents/plan-critic.toml identically (ASCII variant of the same sentence)
3. Update the closed-vocabulary line in .github/agents/plan-critic.agent.md identically
4. Update .agents/evals/test_plan_critic_contract.py so the vocabulary probe pins the new row-verdict set instead of the old one, keeping the top-level VERDICT assertion untouched

FORECAST-REFINE: dev-multi ~11k (4 files, all text edits)

## Tests
- .agents/evals/test_plan_critic_contract.py::test_verdict_vocabulary_is_closed re-pinned to the new row-verdict set and re-run
- .agents/evals/test_plan_critic_contract.py::test_mandatory_enumeration_present_on_all_hosts re-run unchanged, to prove the 7 rows survived the edit

## Rollback
Revert the commit. Every step is a text edit under version control; no state file is written, no waiver register entry is added and no data migration runs, so a code revert alone restores the prior contract.
